name: jsonata
description: Evaluate [JSONata](https://jsonata.org/) expressions against JSON values from inside DuckDB SQL. Best fit: reshaping nested JSON into a new shape, predicate filters on arrays, and concise traversals that get verbose in chains of `json_extract`. Implemented as a single scalar function — no `ATTACH` interface, no secrets.

cta.title: JSONata expressions inside SQL
cta.description: Install the JSONata extension to evaluate JSONata expressions against JSON columns — for path traversal, conditional reshaping, and array transforms that are awkward in plain SQL.
